scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @teerific/shared && npm run build --workspace @teerific/backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @teerific/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @teerific/backend && npm run typecheck --workspace frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend "npm run dev --workspace @teerific/backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
